inSimpleTerms: Defines the open source community standards, guidelines, and behavioral pledge for engineers and public contributors collaborating on the Twitter Recommendation Algorithm repository.
whyThisExists: Establishes institutional governance, anti-harassment policies, and reporting escalation paths for public open-source contributions under standard Contributor Covenant guidelines.
howItAffectsYourReach: No direct feed ranking impact; governs contributor repository interactions, PR review decorum, and community compliance.
theGoldenRule: Maintain professional, respectful, and constructive code review discourse when discussing algorithmic heuristics and moderation mechanics.

inSimpleTerms: The GNU Affero General Public License v3.0 (AGPL-3.0) legal agreement under which Twitter/X released its recommendation algorithm source code to the public.
whyThisExists: Enforces full open-source transparency by requiring any modified network-deployed versions of the recommendation engine or ranking pipeline to also make their complete source code publicly accessible under AGPL-3.0.
howItAffectsYourReach: Ensures algorithmic accountability and legal compliance across derived recommendation services and third-party feed simulators.
theGoldenRule: Any derivative service, ranking fork, or hosted modification of this pipeline must remain open-source under identical AGPL-3.0 copyleft terms.

inSimpleTerms: The master architectural documentation that outlines Twitter/X's end-to-end recommendation pipeline, explaining candidate sourcing, Heavy Ranker neural networks, SimClusters, and visibility filtering.
whyThisExists: Provides the structural blueprint for how hundreds of microservices orchestrate the extraction of ~1,500 candidate tweets from a pool of 500 million daily tweets to construct the 'For You' timeline in under 1.5 seconds.
howItAffectsYourReach: Explains the foundational 50/50 balance between In-Network (RealGraph/Search Index) and Out-of-Network (SimClusters/GraphJet/UTG) candidate generation stages that determine initial post discovery.
theGoldenRule: Optimize for bidirectional graph engagement (mutual interactions) and high-affinity topic clustering to maximize both In-Network recall and Out-of-Network candidate generation.

inSimpleTerms: Architectural change log and post-mortem detailing the algorithmic adjustment that prioritizes bidirectional follow graphs and mutual conversation engagement over one-way broadcast following.
whyThisExists: Documents the transition to heavily weight mutual interaction graphs, counteracting one-sided broadcast spam and low-engagement follower hoarding.
howItAffectsYourReach: Significantly amplifies tweets when the author and audience have reciprocal follow or reply histories (up to a 2x-4x boost multiplier in RealGraph scoring), while dampening passive unidirectional follower distributions.
theGoldenRule: Cultivate authentic two-way conversations and mutual connections rather than passive broadcast follower counts to capitalize on bidirectional graph boosts.

inSimpleTerms: Root Bazel build definition that aggregates and exposes the `media-model-proxy` service binary and library targets across Twitter's monorepo build graph.
whyThisExists: Defines modular compilation boundaries, JVM memory allocation limits, and dependency resolution rules for the Media Model Proxy Finatra microservice.
howItAffectsYourReach: Ensures the media annotation infrastructure builds deterministically; compilation failures would halt deployment of updated media safety, hateful symbol, and categorization models.
theGoldenRule: Maintain clean dependency modularity across Finagle Thrift clients and DeepBird runtime wrappers to avoid JVM classpath conflicts.

inSimpleTerms: Technical overview and operational runbook for the Media Model Proxy (cortex-media-annotator), explaining how it mediates between upstream media uploaders and backend DeepBird v2 ML models.
whyThisExists: Documents the service's role as a unified high-throughput gateway that handles image downloading from BlobStore, batched model scoring, scribe audit logging, and feature flag management.
howItAffectsYourReach: Governs how visual assets attached to tweets are analyzed for NSFW, gore, hateful iconography, and topic categories before reaching the recommendation feed.
theGoldenRule: Ensure media attachments are compliant with safety policies and high in topical clarity to prevent automated downstream suppression or safety downgrades.

inSimpleTerms: Central dynamic configuration file declaring Decider feature flags and percentage-based traffic splits for every vision model hosted on DeepBird v2.
whyThisExists: Enables zero-downtime canary deployments, percentage ramp-ups, and instant kill switches for model inference without redeploying the JVM binary during cluster outages.
howItAffectsYourReach: Controls the rollout percentage of safety filters (e.g. `xx_nsfw_model_enabled`, `violence_and_gore_model_enabled`); when enabled at 100%, every media upload is strictly evaluated for reach-limiting violations.
theGoldenRule: Assume safety and category classifiers are active at 100% saturation in production; never rely on partial traffic rollout bypasses.

inSimpleTerms: Local developer execution script that provisions an isolated test environment with mocked DeepBird endpoints, local Deciders, and test Thrift servers.
whyThisExists: Allows ML systems engineers to validate end-to-end Thrift RPC requests, BlobStore fetching, and model response serialization on local developer workstations.
howItAffectsYourReach: Ensures proxy routing and image deserialization bugs are caught prior to staging and production deployments.
theGoldenRule: Validate model descriptor Thrift mappings against realistic mock payloads before merging proxy modifications.

inSimpleTerms: Continuous Integration (CI) orchestration script that automates build verification, unit test execution, and integration test validation for the media proxy.
whyThisExists: Enforces automated quality gates in the deployment pipeline, preventing broken model client proxies or malformed decider configurations from reaching production clusters.
howItAffectsYourReach: Protects the availability and low-latency SLA of media safety filters, preventing unclassified or erroneously flagged content from destabilizing the feed.
theGoldenRule: Always verify that automated CI workflow suites pass all descriptor contracts across both staging and production profiles.

inSimpleTerms: Bazel resource definition exposing test fixtures, mock data files, and descriptor models for integration test execution.
whyThisExists: Packages static integration test resources (such as `models.txt`) into the Bazel hermetic test sandbox.
howItAffectsYourReach: Guarantees test suite reproducibility across all CI workers and developer environments.
theGoldenRule: Keep integration test fixture dependencies hermetic within Bazel build boundaries.

inSimpleTerms: Manifest listing the active ML models (NSFW, Gore, Category Classification, Hateful Symbols, Fingerprinting) subject to end-to-end integration validation.
whyThisExists: Provides a single source of truth for all production model IDs that must be validated during integration test sweeps.
howItAffectsYourReach: Defines the exact suite of visual comprehension and safety models that evaluate every tweet media upload.
theGoldenRule: Audit active model IDs against production deciders to ensure all media classification dimensions are properly monitored.

inSimpleTerms: Bazel build rule for the Scala integration test suite covering end-to-end Media Model Proxy Thrift service endpoints.
whyThisExists: Compiles and links the integration test suite against Finatra test harnesses, TwitterUtil, and Finagle Thrift client libraries.
howItAffectsYourReach: Prevents regression in end-to-end RPC serialization and model inference pipelining.
theGoldenRule: Keep integration test targets decoupled from live network endpoints using embedded Finatra server harnesses.

inSimpleTerms: Helper class that spins up an in-memory Media Model Proxy Finatra Thrift server with overridden test modules for integration testing.
whyThisExists: Provides a lifecycle-managed test server fixture that can bind to ephemeral ports and intercept downstream DeepBird / BlobStore RPC calls during test assertions.
howItAffectsYourReach: Verifies that the proxy correctly parses Thrift media requests and returns valid safety and category scores.
theGoldenRule: Use isolated in-memory Finatra servers with mock client injection for deterministic integration testing.

inSimpleTerms: Comprehensive integration test suite that sends real Thrift annotation requests to the test proxy server and asserts correct response parsing for various image categories.
whyThisExists: Validates the full request lifecycle: Thrift decoding, BlobStore image retrieval, DeepBird feature conversion, inference execution, and Thrift response encoding.
howItAffectsYourReach: Guarantees that classification scores (e.g. NSFW probability, hateful symbol detection) accurately reflect model outputs before being written to tweet metadata.
theGoldenRule: Confirm that all model descriptors maintain strict contract backward compatibility across Thrift schema revisions.

inSimpleTerms: Bazel target package definition for the Media Model Proxy load testing and stress benchmarking framework.
whyThisExists: Enables compilation and packaging of high-concurrency load generation binaries capable of simulating peak Twitter traffic loads.
howItAffectsYourReach: Ensures the service can withstand tens of thousands of QPS during breaking news events without dropping media requests or causing downstream feed delays.
theGoldenRule: Benchmark proxy throughput and p99 latency against production-scale synthetic load profiles.

inSimpleTerms: Configuration file specifying concurrency levels, target QPS rates, duration, and endpoint URIs for load test simulations.
whyThisExists: Allows performance engineers to parameterize stress test runs, ramping from baseline traffic to 5x peak burst loads.
howItAffectsYourReach: Validates that under heavy server saturation, load-shedding filters gracefully degrade optional models while preserving critical safety filters.
theGoldenRule: Ensure load testing parameters accurately reflect production traffic distributions between image classification and visual fingerprinting.

inSimpleTerms: Shell script that orchestrates the execution of the load testing binary with configured JVM garbage collection flags and target cluster hosts.
whyThisExists: Standardizes the execution environment for stress tests across Aurora / Mesos test clusters.
howItAffectsYourReach: Helps engineers identify GC pauses or thread contention that could introduce p99 latency spikes in media processing.
theGoldenRule: Tune JVM heap and garbage collection parameters under realistic load test conditions to avoid inference latency degradation.

inSimpleTerms: Git ignore rule that prevents ephemeral benchmark logs, latency histograms, and GC traces from being committed to the repository.
whyThisExists: Maintains repository cleanliness by excluding gigabytes of transient load testing metrics and benchmark dumps.
howItAffectsYourReach: No direct feed impact; maintains build repo hygiene.
theGoldenRule: Keep performance logs and execution traces out of version control.

inSimpleTerms: Bazel build rule for the Scala load test runner and log sampling utilities.
whyThisExists: Compiles high-performance Finagle Thrift clients and async request pipelines tailored for load generation.
howItAffectsYourReach: Verifies that load generator clients accurately simulate real-world Thrift call patterns without client-side bottlenecks.
theGoldenRule: Isolate load generation dependencies to avoid polluting core production libraries.

inSimpleTerms: Load testing runner that generates thousands of concurrent Thrift requests against Media Model Proxy using Finagle async clients and records latency percentiles.
whyThisExists: Stress-tests proxy connection pools, thread pools, and CPU utilization under simulated peak Twitter upload traffic.
howItAffectsYourReach: Identifies system saturation points where high inference latency could cause downstream recommendation pipelines to time out on media scoring.
theGoldenRule: Design async service pipelines to maintain sub-50ms p99 latency even under multi-thousand QPS stress loads.

inSimpleTerms: Utility that replays and samples real production Scribe query logs to produce realistic, non-synthetic request distributions for load tests.
whyThisExists: Synthetic load tests often miss real-world request skews (e.g. image size distributions, popular model ID distributions); replaying sampled logs accurately reproduces production workloads.
howItAffectsYourReach: Ensures performance tuning reflects actual creator image formats, aspect ratios, and category requests.
theGoldenRule: Replay production-derived traffic samples to accurately profile cache hit rates and memory allocation under real user distributions.

inSimpleTerms: Developer startup script that launches the Media Model Proxy service locally with staging credentials, local deciders, and mock backends.
whyThisExists: Enables rapid iteration for developers modifying model descriptors, deciders, or Thrift controllers without deploying to remote clusters.
howItAffectsYourReach: Speeds up development and validation cycles for new media understanding features and safety classifiers.
theGoldenRule: Use local script configurations to verify model descriptor conversions against sample images before submitting PRs.

inSimpleTerms: Bazel build file defining packaging and distribution rules for all static configuration resources, SAML metadata, and sample test images.
whyThisExists: Ensures all non-code assets (XML metadata, JSON instance configs, test assets) are bundled correctly into the deployable JAR / PEX bundle.
howItAffectsYourReach: Guarantees runtime availability of critical service configs and authentication metadata.
theGoldenRule: Explicitly declare all runtime resource dependencies in Bazel build targets to avoid missing resource exceptions at runtime.

inSimpleTerms: Java ServiceLoader registration file that binds dynamic Tunable configuration maps into Twitter's runtime utility framework.
whyThisExists: Enables zero-restart dynamic reconfiguration of concurrency limits, timeouts, and load-shedding parameters via Twitter's centralized Tunables infrastructure.
howItAffectsYourReach: Allows operations teams to dynamically adjust model scoring timeouts and load-shedding thresholds in real time during traffic spikes.
theGoldenRule: Register tunable service providers cleanly so dynamic parameter changes take effect without service restarts.

inSimpleTerms: JSON configuration defining default tunable keys, IDs, and dynamic thresholds for the cortex-media-annotator proxy instance.
whyThisExists: Specifies instance-level knobs such as request concurrency limits and model-specific execution timeouts for the media annotator.
howItAffectsYourReach: Tunes latency budgets for visual model inference; aggressive timeouts could drop non-critical media category classifications under load.
theGoldenRule: Set reasonable default execution budgets in instance tunables to protect critical safety filters from being shed.

inSimpleTerms: SAML identity provider metadata configuration for Okta authentication in staging and development management interfaces.
whyThisExists: Secures administrative endpoints, feature flag toggles, and internal debugging consoles behind Okta single sign-on (SSO).
howItAffectsYourReach: Protects internal algorithmic controls and feature flags from unauthorized external tampering.
theGoldenRule: Enforce strict SSO authentication boundaries for all internal administrative and feature-flag management tools.

inSimpleTerms: Production SAML identity provider metadata configuration for Okta authentication on production management endpoints.
whyThisExists: Enforces enterprise-grade production access control for Cortex media annotator admin panels and operational monitoring consoles.
howItAffectsYourReach: Secures production decider overrides and model deployment switches against unauthenticated modifications.
theGoldenRule: Audit production authentication metadata regularly to ensure administrative access is strictly restricted to authorized on-call engineers.

inSimpleTerms: A standard JPEG test image bundled with the service for smoke tests, health checks, and baseline model inference validation.
whyThisExists: Provides a fixed, known binary asset that can be passed through BlobStore fetchers and DeepBird models during startup health checks and canary validation.
howItAffectsYourReach: Ensures the image decoding and tensor transformation pipeline is functional before the service accepts public traffic.
theGoldenRule: Use fixed, deterministic test assets during startup probes to verify end-to-end model inference pipelines.

inSimpleTerms: Bazel build rule for the main Media Model Proxy application entry point and server startup classes.
whyThisExists: Compiles the Finatra Thrift server binary, bundling all controllers, dependency injection modules, and monitoring hooks.
howItAffectsYourReach: Defines the deployable artifact that powers visual understanding across all tweet media uploads.
theGoldenRule: Ensure clean separation between application bootstrap code and domain logic for fast, reliable server startup.

inSimpleTerms: Startup validator that pings and verifies connectivity to all configured DeepBird v2 model endpoints before the server marks itself healthy in routing meshes.
whyThisExists: Prevents the server from accepting live traffic if downstream model endpoints (NSFW, Gore, Categories) are unreachable or misconfigured.
howItAffectsYourReach: Protects against silent failures where media uploads might bypass safety and topic categorization due to broken backend connections.
theGoldenRule: Fail fast at startup if critical downstream model dependencies fail health validation probes.

inSimpleTerms: Main Finatra Thrift server definition that configures port bindings, filter chains, dependency injection modules, and lifecycle warm-up sequences.
whyThisExists: Assembles the entire Media Model Proxy microservice, setting up Twitter Server admin endpoints, load-shedding filters, Decider configurations, and Thrift routing.
howItAffectsYourReach: The foundational serving layer through which all media classification requests must pass before tweets can be indexed or served.
theGoldenRule: Configure warm-up sequences and graceful shutdown handlers to prevent request drops during service redeployments.

inSimpleTerms: Bazel build definition for the model client abstraction layer and DeepBird integration clients.
whyThisExists: Compiles client interfaces, switching mechanisms, and DeepBird v2 Thrift adapters with proper dependency boundaries.
howItAffectsYourReach: Guarantees reliable RPC communication between the proxy and distributed GPU/CPU model inference clusters.
theGoldenRule: Decouple generic model client interfaces from vendor-specific or cluster-specific RPC protocols.

inSimpleTerms: Production Finagle Thrift client that communicates with Twitter's DeepBird v2 machine learning serving clusters to execute tensor inference.
whyThisExists: Translates high-level media requests into DeepBird v2 prediction requests, handling connection pooling, retries, latency stats, and response unpacking.
howItAffectsYourReach: The primary execution engine for visual deep learning; returns classification probabilities and dense embeddings that power both safety filtering and topic recommendation.
theGoldenRule: Maintain low request payload overhead and optimal connection pooling to keep deep learning inference latency within strict SLA limits.

inSimpleTerms: Mock and fallback model client that returns deterministic, synthetic embeddings and classification responses for testing and disaster recovery.
whyThisExists: Enables local testing without access to live DeepBird GPU clusters and provides a safe fallback mechanism during total backend model cluster outages.
howItAffectsYourReach: When fallback mode is triggered, returns safe default embeddings to prevent total service failure while alerting operations to backend cluster degradation.
theGoldenRule: Ensure mock/fallback clients return structurally identical feature vectors to prevent downstream deserialization crashes.

inSimpleTerms: Core Scala trait (interface) defining the contract for model scoring clients, accepting media tensors and returning model predictions.
whyThisExists: Provides a clean polymorphic abstraction layer so the proxy can transparently switch between live DeepBird clusters, dark traffic proxies, and mock clients.
howItAffectsYourReach: Standardizes prediction contracts across diverse visual models (classification, embeddings, detection).
theGoldenRule: Adhere strictly to asynchronous Future-based contracts to avoid blocking Finagle event loops during model evaluation.

inSimpleTerms: A dynamic router client that inspects Decider feature flags to route traffic between live DeepBird models, dark-traffic canaries, or mock fallbacks.
whyThisExists: Enables zero-downtime model migration, canary rollouts, and dark-traffic shadowing where a new model receives traffic in parallel to evaluate accuracy without impacting production.
howItAffectsYourReach: Determines whether your media is scored by legacy classifiers or newly deployed computer vision models during A/B testing phases.
theGoldenRule: Monitor dark-traffic telemetry and canary divergence metrics before promoting new vision models to 100% serving.

inSimpleTerms: Bazel build file for the configuration package, compiling Deciders, Tunables, and Feature flag wrappers.
whyThisExists: Packages configuration parsing logic and dynamic flag evaluation classes for the media proxy.
howItAffectsYourReach: Ensures configuration modules compile cleanly with full access to Twitter's dynamic feature flagging libraries.
theGoldenRule: Keep configuration dependencies lightweight to avoid slowing down build and test cycles.

inSimpleTerms: Simple configuration case class holding global service parameters, cluster identifiers, and environment metadata.
whyThisExists: Centralizes service-level environment properties (e.g. data center zone, environment name) into an immutable container.
howItAffectsYourReach: Helps route requests to the nearest regional DeepBird and BlobStore data center to minimize latency.
theGoldenRule: Use immutable configuration objects to ensure thread safety across high-concurrency request handlers.

inSimpleTerms: Enumeration and helper definitions for all Decider feature flags used across the Media Model Proxy service.
whyThisExists: Provides type-safe access to string-based Decider keys, preventing runtime typos and missing flag errors.
howItAffectsYourReach: Defines the exact flag names that gate NSFW detection, gore filtering, hateful symbol tagging, and category classification.
theGoldenRule: Use type-safe decider constants instead of raw strings to guarantee feature flag integrity across releases.

inSimpleTerms: Service class that evaluates dynamic feature flags and decider percentages to determine which models should execute for a given request.
whyThisExists: Encapsulates complex feature flag logic (e.g., checking if dark traffic is enabled, if a specific model ID is active, or if load shedding should bypass embeddings).
howItAffectsYourReach: Directly governs which computer vision models score your upload; inactive models are skipped, while active ones produce annotations that govern feed distribution.
theGoldenRule: Ensure feature flag evaluations are ultra-fast in-memory operations to avoid adding latency overhead to the request path.

inSimpleTerms: Factory that constructs dynamic Tunable maps backed by Twitter's central distributed configuration service.
whyThisExists: Allows operational knobs (timeouts, rate limits, load shedding percentages) to be modified globally in seconds without deploying code.
howItAffectsYourReach: Under extreme traffic spikes, operations can dynamically raise load-shedding percentages to shed non-essential media classification jobs.
theGoldenRule: Leverage dynamic tunables for operational knobs that may need immediate adjustment during high-traffic events.

inSimpleTerms: Defines specific typed Tunable keys for the Media Model Proxy, such as client timeouts, retry budgets, and concurrency bounds.
whyThisExists: Provides strongly-typed access to dynamic tunables, ensuring that timeout and concurrency values are validated at parse time.
howItAffectsYourReach: Governs the time budget allocated for image analysis; if a model exceeds its tunable timeout, the request fails open or falls back.
theGoldenRule: Calibrate tunable timeouts to allow deep learning inference to complete while strictly bounding tail latency.

inSimpleTerms: Bazel build rule for the Finatra Thrift controller package handling inbound annotation requests.
whyThisExists: Compiles Thrift controller classes and links them with Thrift request/response generated bindings.
howItAffectsYourReach: Ensures the public API layer of the media annotator compiles cleanly and efficiently.
theGoldenRule: Keep controller logic focused on request validation, delegation to service layers, and response mapping.

inSimpleTerms: Primary Finatra Thrift controller that receives `annotate` RPC calls, validates input parameters, delegates scoring to `ModelsService`, and formats responses.
whyThisExists: Acts as the main API endpoint for upstream services (Tweetypie, Media Pipeline, Safety Enforcers) requesting media classification and embeddings.
howItAffectsYourReach: The entry point for all media evaluation; parses requested model IDs (NSFW, Gore, Categories, Fingerprints) and returns structured scores that determine visibility.
theGoldenRule: Ensure media URLs and metadata passed to the proxy are well-formed so requests process without validation errors.

inSimpleTerms: Bazel build rule for custom exception definitions used throughout the Media Model Proxy.
whyThisExists: Compiles domain-specific exception types and error handling utilities.
howItAffectsYourReach: Ensures error classes compile cleanly across service modules.
theGoldenRule: Use strongly-typed exceptions to distinguish between transient network retries and fatal client errors.

inSimpleTerms: Defines custom domain exceptions for model timeouts, missing descriptors, BlobStore retrieval failures, and unsupported media types.
whyThisExists: Allows the service to categorize errors accurately for metrics, alerts, and client-facing Thrift error responses.
howItAffectsYourReach: Distinguishes between transient backend failures (which trigger automatic retries) and permanent media corruption errors.
theGoldenRule: Catch and categorize errors cleanly to prevent unhandled exceptions from crashing the request pipeline.

inSimpleTerms: Bazel build rule for all computer vision model descriptor implementations and registry classes.
whyThisExists: Compiles model-specific input tensor converters, output decoders, and descriptor registry mappings.
howItAffectsYourReach: Houses the code that defines how every neural network interprets images and outputs classification scores.
theGoldenRule: Maintain high test coverage across all descriptor transformations to prevent silent model scoring bugs.

inSimpleTerms: Model descriptor that extracts dense semantic embedding vectors from media to represent visual concepts in high-dimensional topic space.
whyThisExists: Translates raw image bytes into DeepBird tensor inputs and converts the output hidden layer into a dense float vector for downstream SimClusters and topic matching.
howItAffectsYourReach: Directly feeds visual semantic embeddings into Twitter's interest-based recommendation algorithms, matching your media to users interested in related topics.
theGoldenRule: Post visually rich and topic-focused media to generate strong, high-affinity semantic embedding vectors.

inSimpleTerms: Model descriptor that classifies images into high-level categories (e.g. Sports, Politics, Gaming, Art) with associated confidence probabilities.
whyThisExists: Defines feature transformation and output label mapping for multi-class visual topic categorization models on DeepBird.
howItAffectsYourReach: Categorizes tweets with media into topical channels and explore feeds; high confidence scores boost relevance in topic-filtered recommendation streams.
theGoldenRule: Align visual media clearly with the tweet's subject matter to maximize category classification confidence scores.

inSimpleTerms: Model descriptor that computes perceptual hashes and visual fingerprints of images to detect exact and near-duplicate media across Twitter.
whyThisExists: Enables instant duplicate detection, copyright enforcement, and rapid propagation of safety moderation decisions across identical media assets.
howItAffectsYourReach: If an image's fingerprint matches a previously flagged spam or policy-violating asset, the tweet is instantly downranked or withheld without running full inference.
theGoldenRule: Avoid reposting watermarked spam or previously penalized imagery, as perceptual fingerprinting matches near-duplicates instantly.

inSimpleTerms: Second-generation visual fingerprinting descriptor featuring enhanced robustness against cropping, rotation, color filters, and compression artifacts.
whyThisExists: Improves upon v1 fingerprinting by utilizing deeper neural representations that resist adversarial perturbations and minor media edits.
howItAffectsYourReach: Prevents bad actors from bypassing visual moderation filters by applying minor filters or crops to prohibited content.
theGoldenRule: Original, high-quality visual content generates unique fingerprints that build positive organic reputation in the recommendation graph.

inSimpleTerms: Model descriptor specialized in identifying hate symbols, extremist iconography, and prohibited emblems in uploaded images.
whyThisExists: Provides dedicated computer vision inference for hateful symbol detection, mapping model prediction tensors to specific policy violation flags.
howItAffectsYourReach: Any positive detection above threshold triggers severe visibility filtering, immediate removal from For You recommendations, and potential account-level strikes.
theGoldenRule: Strictly avoid including any ambiguous or prohibited iconography, as automated hateful symbol classifiers apply zero-tolerance visibility penalties.

inSimpleTerms: Base abstract trait defining the contract for model descriptors, including input tensor preparation, output parsing, model ID mapping, and Decider key binding.
whyThisExists: Standardizes how disparate deep learning models interface with the proxy, enforcing consistent error handling, feature extraction, and response formatting.
howItAffectsYourReach: The foundational template ensuring all computer vision models are scored, logged, and evaluated consistently across the platform.
theGoldenRule: Follow uniform descriptor contracts to ensure new ML models seamlessly integrate into the media annotation pipeline.

inSimpleTerms: Central registry that maps model string identifiers (e.g., `xx_nsfw`, `violence_and_gore`, `category_classification`) to their corresponding `ModelDescriptor` instances.
whyThisExists: Provides fast O(1) lookup of model descriptors by name when incoming Thrift requests specify a list of desired model evaluations.
howItAffectsYourReach: Ensures requested model evaluations are dispatched to the exact corresponding model pipelines without overhead or routing errors.
theGoldenRule: Register all active model descriptors in the central registry with unique, descriptive model keys.

inSimpleTerms: Model descriptor that scores images for graphic violence, gore, physical trauma, and weapon presence.
whyThisExists: Provides dedicated feature parsing and threshold evaluation for DeepBird violence detection models to protect users from graphic content.
howItAffectsYourReach: Elevated violence/gore scores add sensitive media interstitial warnings, disable autoplay, and exclude the tweet from general Out-of-Network recommendations.
theGoldenRule: Mark sensitive or graphic content appropriately using media tags to avoid algorithmic penalties or shadow-suppression.

inSimpleTerms: Model descriptor that processes adult content (NSFW) classification, detecting nudity, sexually explicit imagery, and suggestive content.
whyThisExists: Converts raw image bytes into feature representations for Twitter's XX NSFW neural network and maps output probabilities to fine-grained adult content tags.
howItAffectsYourReach: High NSFW confidence scores automatically apply adult content interstitials, restrict distribution to consenting adult accounts, and disqualify the tweet from the For You explore tab.
theGoldenRule: Accurately self-label adult content to preserve account standing and prevent system-wide visibility downranking.

inSimpleTerms: Bazel build rule for Google Guice dependency injection modules configuring service components, clients, and filters.
whyThisExists: Compiles all dependency injection bindings for Finagle clients, BlobStore services, Scribe loggers, and feature modules.
howItAffectsYourReach: Ensures DI configuration compiles cleanly with correct lifecycle management across the service.
theGoldenRule: Structure Guice modules with clear, explicit provider methods to simplify test overrides and dependency injection.

inSimpleTerms: Guice module providing configured, connection-pooled Finagle HTTP/Thrift clients for downloading media assets from Twitter's internal BlobStore.
whyThisExists: Manages connection lifecycles, read timeouts, backoff retries, and mutual TLS authentication when fetching media binaries from distributed BlobStore storage clusters.
howItAffectsYourReach: Ensures uploaded images are fetched with ultra-low latency; retrieval timeouts would delay or prevent media classification.
theGoldenRule: Configure resilient connection pooling and backoff policies for storage cluster clients to withstand transient network blips.

inSimpleTerms: Guice module that binds environment configuration, service identifiers, and port flags into the dependency injection graph.
whyThisExists: Provides centralized injection of global configuration objects across controllers and services.
howItAffectsYourReach: Ensures all service components operate with consistent environment and data center configurations.
theGoldenRule: Inject immutable configuration classes through dedicated Guice provider modules.

inSimpleTerms: Guice module that initializes Decider feature flag clients and binds the `Features` service helper.
whyThisExists: Wires Twitter's Decider framework into the application, enabling dynamic feature gating across all model evaluation paths.
howItAffectsYourReach: Governs the active rollout percentages of all safety and categorization models across production clusters.
theGoldenRule: Ensure Decider clients are properly initialized with local fallback bases in test and development environments.

inSimpleTerms: Guice module configuring Finagle load-shedding filters to reject or degrade non-critical requests when CPU or queue thresholds are exceeded.
whyThisExists: Protects the service from catastrophic failure during massive traffic spikes by dropping low-priority requests while keeping core safety pipelines alive.
howItAffectsYourReach: During severe server overload, load shedding prioritizes safety moderation (NSFW/violence) over optional embeddings and category generation.
theGoldenRule: Design load-shedding filters with clear tier-based priority shedding so critical safety functions remain operational under stress.

inSimpleTerms: Core Guice module that binds model descriptors, registry singletons, and controller routes for the Media Model Proxy.
whyThisExists: Assembles the core domain dependencies of the proxy, registering all active model descriptors into the central registry.
howItAffectsYourReach: Ensures all visual understanding models are properly instantiated and available for incoming Thrift annotation requests.
theGoldenRule: Register all new model descriptors in the main module to make them available to the service registry.

inSimpleTerms: Guice module that binds DeepBird v2 model clients, switching proxies, and fallback clients for each registered model type.
whyThisExists: Configures Finagle Thrift clients connected to DeepBird GPU/CPU clusters, injecting circuit breakers, retries, and Decider switches.
howItAffectsYourReach: Manages the execution pipelines that score images for topic modeling and safety classification.
theGoldenRule: Use switching model clients to enable safe canary rollouts and A/B testing of new deep learning models.

inSimpleTerms: Guice module configuring Twitter's Scribe distributed logging client for asynchronous audit trail publishing.
whyThisExists: Provides non-blocking logging infrastructure to record model inference results, latencies, and input hashes for offline analysis.
howItAffectsYourReach: Logs media classification decisions to data pipelines, feeding training data lakes that continuously retrain recommendation and safety models.
theGoldenRule: Use asynchronous, buffered Scribe clients to prevent audit logging from adding latency to real-time inference.

inSimpleTerms: Guice module that binds Twitter's Finagle `StatsReceiver` for exporting real-time metrics, counters, and latency gauges.
whyThisExists: Exposes critical observability metrics (QPS, p50/p99 latency, error rates, model score distributions) to Grafana and alerting systems.
howItAffectsYourReach: Enables automated alerts that trigger on-call engineering interventions if media classification error rates spike.
theGoldenRule: Instrument all model inference and network operations with fine-grained Finagle metrics for comprehensive observability.

inSimpleTerms: Guice module integrating Twitter's Diffy tool for shadow traffic comparison and regression testing across model versions.
whyThisExists: Allows new versions of the Media Model Proxy to run in parallel with production, comparing response diffs on real traffic without affecting users.
howItAffectsYourReach: Guarantees that algorithmic and model updates produce intended output distributions before going live.
theGoldenRule: Leverage Diffy shadow-proxying to validate behavioral parity when refactoring model descriptors or upgrading Thrift schemas.

inSimpleTerms: Scala package object defining shared type aliases, constants, and implicit conversions across the modules package.
whyThisExists: Reduces boilerplate by providing package-wide utility methods and standard type definitions.
howItAffectsYourReach: Maintains clean, consistent code structure across dependency injection definitions.
theGoldenRule: Centralize package-level constants and utility aliases in package objects to avoid duplicated boilerplate.

inSimpleTerms: Bazel build rule for the core business logic services (ModelsService and BlobStoreService).
whyThisExists: Compiles service layer implementations that coordinate media fetching and model scoring.
howItAffectsYourReach: Houses the business logic responsible for media analysis and safety scoring.
theGoldenRule: Keep business logic modularized and decoupled from specific transport controllers.

inSimpleTerms: Service layer handling asynchronous fetching of raw media binary assets from Twitter's internal BlobStore.
whyThisExists: Encapsulates media retrieval, error handling, content-type validation, and byte buffer management when downloading user-uploaded images.
howItAffectsYourReach: Fast, reliable image downloads ensure that media understanding algorithms have the raw bytes needed to score posts in real time.
theGoldenRule: Implement aggressive timeout and connection reuse policies when retrieving media assets from distributed blob storage.

inSimpleTerms: Core orchestration service that concurrently dispatches media evaluation requests across multiple machine learning models.
whyThisExists: Coordinates parallel model evaluation: receives a media request, queries BlobStore, determines active models via Deciders, fans out inference calls across DeepBird, collects results, logs to Scribe, and returns combined scores.
howItAffectsYourReach: The central nexus of media understanding; simultaneously computes NSFW, Gore, Category, and Embedding scores that dictate whether a tweet is amplified, categorized, or suppressed.
theGoldenRule: Use non-blocking asynchronous concurrency (e.g. `Future.collect`) to execute multiple deep learning evaluations in parallel within strict latency SLAs.

inSimpleTerms: Bazel build rule for utility classes, including Scribe logging and helper formatters.
whyThisExists: Compiles logging and auditing utility libraries used throughout the proxy.
howItAffectsYourReach: Ensures utility libraries compile cleanly with minimal dependency footprints.
theGoldenRule: Keep utility libraries pure and free of heavy domain dependencies.

inSimpleTerms: Utility class that formats model evaluation inputs, prediction outputs, and execution metadata into Thrift structs and publishes them to Scribe.
whyThisExists: Provides structured, asynchronous audit logging of all media classification events for offline analytics, safety auditing, and model training.
howItAffectsYourReach: Persists media classification records to long-term storage, enabling continuous evaluation of model fairness and accuracy over time.
theGoldenRule: Buffer and serialize Scribe records asynchronously to eliminate IO overhead on the critical inference path.

inSimpleTerms: Scala trait defining the interface for publishing audit log messages to Scribe log categories.
whyThisExists: Decouples log generation logic from the underlying Scribe transport, facilitating mock implementations in unit tests.
howItAffectsYourReach: Ensures reliable, mockable telemetry publishing across the media proxy pipeline.
theGoldenRule: Abstract logging sinks behind clean interfaces to enable lightweight, mockable unit testing.

inSimpleTerms: Bazel build rule for compiling Apache Thrift IDL definition files into Scala and Java RPC stubs.
whyThisExists: Automates the generation of strongly-typed Thrift client and server code for the `cortex_media_annotator` service.
howItAffectsYourReach: Ensures RPC data structures remain backward-compatible across all internal services communicating with the media proxy.
theGoldenRule: Maintain strict backward compatibility in Thrift IDL schemas by never changing field IDs or types.

inSimpleTerms: Apache Thrift IDL defining the public API for the media annotator, including `MediaAnnotationRequest`, `MediaAnnotationResponse`, model categories, and feature structs.
whyThisExists: Serves as the formal RPC interface contract between upstream tweet ingestion services and the Media Model Proxy.
howItAffectsYourReach: Defines the exact schema of safety flags (NSFW, gore, hate symbols) and topic categories returned to Tweetypie and feed ranking pipelines.
theGoldenRule: Review Thrift schema definitions to understand the full range of visual metadata dimensions evaluated on user media.

inSimpleTerms: Apache Thrift IDL defining the structured audit logging schema for Scribe log events produced during media annotation.
whyThisExists: Defines the schema for offline data warehouse logging, capturing media IDs, requested model IDs, execution latencies, and prediction tensors.
howItAffectsYourReach: Powers offline model retraining datasets and algorithmic auditing pipelines.
theGoldenRule: Include comprehensive metadata in Scribe logging schemas to support robust offline model evaluation.

inSimpleTerms: Bazel build rule for test resource files, bundling test Deciders and mock configs into the test classpath.
whyThisExists: Packages test fixtures into the Bazel test sandbox for hermetic unit and feature tests.
howItAffectsYourReach: Ensures unit tests run reliably in CI environments without external filesystem dependencies.
theGoldenRule: Declare test resource targets explicitly in Bazel to maintain test hermeticity.

inSimpleTerms: YAML decider configuration used during unit and feature tests, setting all model flags to predictable test percentages.
whyThisExists: Provides a controlled feature flag environment for unit tests, ensuring tests run deterministically without relying on live production Decider servers.
howItAffectsYourReach: Validates that model gating logic operates predictably across both 0% and 100% flag settings.
theGoldenRule: Use deterministic test decider configurations to verify both enabled and disabled code paths in test suites.

inSimpleTerms: Bazel build rule for server startup and feature-level integration tests.
whyThisExists: Compiles server-level test suites that verify application bootstrap and end-to-end request processing.
howItAffectsYourReach: Prevents startup crashes and routing regressions from entering production deployments.
theGoldenRule: Include startup smoke tests to catch dependency injection and configuration errors before deployment.

inSimpleTerms: Comprehensive Finatra feature test that verifies end-to-end Thrift requests against an embedded test server with mocked backends.
whyThisExists: Tests full request/response flows including routing, controller validation, Decider evaluation, and response mapping.
howItAffectsYourReach: Guarantees that the proxy correctly processes media annotation requests and returns expected safety scores across diverse test scenarios.
theGoldenRule: Write comprehensive feature tests for all public RPC endpoints using embedded Finatra test servers.

inSimpleTerms: Fast smoke test that boots the Media Model Proxy Finatra server in test mode and asserts clean startup without dependency injection errors.
whyThisExists: Catches missing Guice bindings, circular dependencies, or invalid configuration files during CI builds before deployment.
howItAffectsYourReach: Ensures server health and operational stability across continuous deployment cycles.
theGoldenRule: Always run startup tests to catch Guice dependency injection errors before shipping.

inSimpleTerms: Bazel build rule for model client unit test specifications.
whyThisExists: Compiles unit tests covering DeepBirdClient, SwitchingModelClient, and DummyEmbeddingsClient.
howItAffectsYourReach: Ensures client layer tests compile and execute cleanly in CI.
theGoldenRule: Maintain dedicated test targets for all client communication components.

inSimpleTerms: Unit test suite for `DeepbirdClient` verifying Thrift request construction, tensor serialization, and error handling when communicating with DeepBird v2.
whyThisExists: Validates that the DeepBird client correctly packs image bytes into prediction requests and properly unpacks returned prediction tensors.
howItAffectsYourReach: Guarantees that deep learning predictions are accurately extracted and parsed without loss of precision.
theGoldenRule: Test client tensor serialization against diverse mock responses to verify boundary condition handling.

inSimpleTerms: Unit test suite verifying the behavior of `DummyEmbeddingsClient` under various test configurations.
whyThisExists: Ensures the mock/fallback client returns correctly formatted embedding vectors of the expected dimensionality.
howItAffectsYourReach: Verifies that fallback embeddings adhere to dimensional and structural contracts during disaster recovery scenarios.
theGoldenRule: Verify that dummy fallback clients produce vectors matching production embedding dimensionality.

inSimpleTerms: Unit test suite testing the dynamic routing and canary switching logic in `SwitchingModelClient`.
whyThisExists: Verifies that traffic correctly shifts between primary, canary, and fallback clients based on Decider percentage changes.
howItAffectsYourReach: Ensures that canary rollouts and dark-traffic experiments route traffic accurately without leaking unvalidated predictions to users.
theGoldenRule: Test all Decider boundary conditions (0%, 50%, 100%) to verify smooth traffic switching across model versions.

inSimpleTerms: Bazel build rule for configuration and feature flag unit tests.
whyThisExists: Compiles test specifications for Decider and Features parsing.
howItAffectsYourReach: Ensures configuration test suites compile cleanly.
theGoldenRule: Maintain high test coverage for configuration and feature flag evaluation logic.

inSimpleTerms: Unit test suite validating that `Features` correctly queries Decider flags and resolves model activation states.
whyThisExists: Verifies that model enablement checks, dark traffic switches, and load shedding flags are evaluated accurately.
howItAffectsYourReach: Prevents logic bugs in feature flag evaluation that could inadvertently disable safety or categorization models.
theGoldenRule: Verify feature evaluation logic against both active and inactive decider state fixtures.

inSimpleTerms: Bazel build rule for all model descriptor unit test specifications.
whyThisExists: Compiles unit tests covering all individual model descriptors (NSFW, Gore, Categories, Fingerprints, Hate Symbols).
howItAffectsYourReach: Ensures all model descriptor test targets build and run reliably in CI.
theGoldenRule: Keep model descriptor test suites modular and parallelizable in Bazel.

inSimpleTerms: Unit test suite validating that category classification embeddings are correctly extracted, formatted into dense float vectors, and mapped to Thrift response structs.
whyThisExists: Ensures semantic embedding vectors are accurately extracted from deep neural network hidden layers without tensor slicing errors.
howItAffectsYourReach: Guarantees that downstream SimClusters and topic recommendation systems receive accurate high-dimensional visual representations.
theGoldenRule: Verify embedding vector dimensions and float precision in unit tests to prevent downstream vector index mismatches.

inSimpleTerms: Unit test suite verifying that multi-class category probabilities and top-K predicted labels are correctly parsed from DeepBird tensors.
whyThisExists: Tests classification label mapping, probability score thresholding, and category ranking logic.
howItAffectsYourReach: Ensures that topic categories assigned to media tweets reflect true model confidence scores.
theGoldenRule: Validate label index mapping against model dictionary files to prevent misclassified topic assignments.

inSimpleTerms: Unit test suite validating that visual fingerprinting hashes are correctly computed and serialized into Thrift response fields.
whyThisExists: Ensures perceptual hash algorithms produce deterministic, reproducible binary signatures from image inputs.
howItAffectsYourReach: Verifies that near-duplicate and spam detection hashes are generated accurately for media tracking.
theGoldenRule: Test fingerprinting outputs against known reference images to ensure hash consistency across releases.

inSimpleTerms: Unit test suite for the second-generation fingerprinting descriptor, verifying enhanced hash stability across image transforms.
whyThisExists: Tests v2 fingerprint generation against rotated, cropped, and resized image fixtures to confirm robustness.
howItAffectsYourReach: Guarantees that modern perceptual hashing algorithms accurately identify media duplicates regardless of light editing.
theGoldenRule: Validate fingerprint stability against common image transformations in automated test suites.

inSimpleTerms: Unit test suite testing tensor parsing and threshold gating for hate symbol recognition models.
whyThisExists: Verifies that prohibited iconography detections correctly map to safety moderation flags in Thrift responses.
howItAffectsYourReach: Ensures that hate symbol detection logic functions accurately without false negative safety leaks.
theGoldenRule: Maintain comprehensive unit test assertions around sensitivity thresholds for hate symbol classification.

inSimpleTerms: Unit test suite verifying that graphic violence and gore probability scores are correctly extracted, classified into severity tiers, and mapped to Thrift structs.
whyThisExists: Tests fine-grained classification across violence categories (e.g. gore, physical violence, weapons) and verifies threshold boundaries.
howItAffectsYourReach: Guarantees that sensitive content classification thresholds are applied accurately before posts reach the feed.
theGoldenRule: Test multi-tier violence thresholds to ensure accurate categorization between mild and severe content.

inSimpleTerms: Unit test suite testing the adult content (NSFW) model descriptor across various prediction probability outputs.
whyThisExists: Verifies that adult content probability tensors are correctly parsed into nudity, suggestive, and explicit sub-category scores.
howItAffectsYourReach: Ensures adult content classification logic correctly triggers NSFW interstitials and explore-tab exclusion rules.
theGoldenRule: Verify NSFW threshold calibrations against edge-case probability scores to prevent misclassification.

inSimpleTerms: Bazel build rule for test dependency injection modules and mock provider classes.
whyThisExists: Compiles test Guice modules used across unit and integration test suites.
howItAffectsYourReach: Ensures test DI modules compile cleanly with proper mock client bindings.
theGoldenRule: Use dedicated test Guice modules to inject mocks cleanly in test environments.

inSimpleTerms: Test Guice modules providing mocked implementations of DeepBirdClient, BlobStoreService, and ScribeLogger for hermetic unit testing.
whyThisExists: Enables unit and integration tests to run entirely in-memory without making network calls to external storage or ML clusters.
howItAffectsYourReach: Ensures test suites run quickly and deterministically in CI pipelines.
theGoldenRule: Provide comprehensive mock module implementations for all external RPC dependencies.

inSimpleTerms: Bazel build rule for service layer unit test specifications.
whyThisExists: Compiles unit tests for ModelsService and BlobStoreService.
howItAffectsYourReach: Ensures service layer unit tests compile and run reliably in CI.
theGoldenRule: Maintain comprehensive unit tests covering all service orchestration paths.

inSimpleTerms: Unit test suite verifying that `BlobStoreService` correctly handles HTTP/Thrift responses, non-200 status codes, and image byte buffer conversions.
whyThisExists: Tests media download error handling, timeout handling, and corrupt payload recovery.
howItAffectsYourReach: Guarantees robust error handling when media downloads fail or experience network latency.
theGoldenRule: Test blob storage retrieval across various network failure modes to ensure graceful degradation.

inSimpleTerms: Comprehensive unit test suite for `ModelsService` testing parallel model dispatch, Decider filtering, Scribe logging, and exception aggregation.
whyThisExists: Verifies the core business logic of the proxy: concurrent model execution, partial failure handling, and response consolidation.
howItAffectsYourReach: Ensures that if one non-critical model fails or times out, the service still returns valid results for the remaining models rather than failing the entire request.
theGoldenRule: Verify partial failure resilience so that a single model timeout does not drop the entire media classification response.

inSimpleTerms: Bazel build rule for utility unit test specifications.
whyThisExists: Compiles unit tests for ScribeLogger and utility helpers.
howItAffectsYourReach: Ensures utility test suites compile cleanly.
theGoldenRule: Test utility components in isolation with dedicated Bazel test targets.

inSimpleTerms: Unit test suite verifying that `ScribeLogger` constructs valid Thrift scribe messages and publishes them without throwing exceptions.
whyThisExists: Validates that audit logging logic never propagates exceptions to the main request pipeline, even if the logging backend is unavailable.
howItAffectsYourReach: Ensures audit logging failures never disrupt real-time media scoring or tweet publishing.
theGoldenRule: Verify that audit logging operations fail silently and safely without blocking critical-path business logic.
